body: The wound meets fear, limitation, and authority: deep doubt about being adequate or legitimate that can harden into self-denial.
business: Worked through, it becomes earned, compassionate mastery.
shadow: Harsh self-judgment, or building walls of competence over the ache.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
